title: A letter can hold a number

spoken.text: There are 3 crates on my barge for every one on yours.

ask.text: Write the claim that stands.

hints.text: A socket cut for a name, and a charge waiting outside it.
One barge is the big pile. Put the count of 3 on the small one.
Multiplying the smaller count by 3 is what makes the two pans meet.

worldFraming.text: Ix has been sitting in the empty one for a while, waiting to be told a number.

ask.text: Charge both cores.

hints.text: A socket cut for a name, and a charge waiting outside it.
The second core has to sit exactly where the first one does.
Together they carry 14, and nothing separates them.

worldFraming.text: A cutter opened this socket at dawn and has not said what goes in it.

ask.text: Name the joint that will not hold, and what it should read.

hints.text: A socket cut for a name, and a charge waiting outside it.
Read down the working. One line does not follow from the one above it.
Line 2 is where the load stops matching.
